title: IFERROR returns its second argument when a text cannot be converted to a number

source.quote: Evaluates an expression and returns a specified value if the expression returns an error; otherwise returns the value of the expression itself.
source.supports: an error in the first argument gives the second

source.quote: VALUE raises an error if the conversion is not possible.

derivation: "abc" is not a number, so VALUE raises an error; IFERROR catches it and returns -1.
notes: The type is left out: VALUE returns a decimal number and -1 is an integer. DAX Guide warns that IFERROR does not catch every runtime error, depending on the execution plan; a constant expression like this one is the simplest case.
